title: Add S6100 corresponding sensors data in sonic-mgmt test repository
author: stcheng
body:
```
TASK [test : Gather sensors] ***************************************************
Monday 23 October 2017  21:57:53 +0000 (0:00:00.088)       0:00:57.755 ******** 
fatal: [str-s6100-acs-2]: FAILED! => {"failed": true, "msg": "ERROR! 'dict object' has no attribute u'Force10-S6100'"}
```

Sensors test will fail because there's no such information in the `sku-sensors-data.yml` in sonic-mgmt repository. This file needs to be updated corresponding to the sensors output.
